procedure: Pre-register label definitions, source documents, abstention criteria, and conflict rules with clinical governance approval.
Have two qualified clinicians label independently from the same immutable case packet, blinded to each other and to all model outputs.
Send disagreements and prespecified quality-control agreements to an independent third clinician who was not involved in model development.
Permit an explicit UNRESOLVED outcome; never force a binary label when source evidence is insufficient.
Lock the packet hash, label-manual version, reviewer credentials, timestamps, and adjudication audit trail before evaluating the judge.
